VA.title: Comparative Report of Local Government Revenues and Expenditures, fiscal 2025
VA.what: Every Virginia county and city reports its spending to the state in these same categories, so the numbers line up from place to place.
VA.scope: day-to-day operations, including the school division
VA.note: This is money spent on day-to-day operations from the general government funds. Education includes the whole school division’s operating spending, paid for with state and federal money as well as local taxes. Capital projects, debt payments and utilities run as businesses are counted separately (below).

NC.agency: North Carolina Department of State Treasurer
NC.title: Annual Financial Information Report (AFIR), county data, fiscal 2025
NC.what: Every North Carolina county files this report with the State Treasurer each year, in the same categories, so the numbers line up from county to county.
NC.spentOn: everything, from all funds (not counting depreciation or money moved between funds)
NC.note: Education is what the county paid to the public schools and the community college, not the schools’ whole budget (the state pays most of that). Debt payments are counted in the total.

GA.title: Report of Local Government Finances, fiscal 2024
GA.fy_label: the fiscal year that ended in 2024
GA.what: Every Georgia county files this report with the Department of Community Affairs each year, using the state’s standard list of government functions, so the numbers line up from county to county.
GA.scope: operations and capital, including utility systems, not debt
GA.spentOn: day-to-day costs and building projects, including utility systems like water and sewer (not counting debt payments or money moved between funds)
GA.note: These are the numbers as the county filed them; they are not audited. Each county picks its own fiscal year, most often ending June 30 or December 31. Consolidated city-county governments (like Athens-Clarke and Augusta-Richmond) also pay for city services. Each “source” link opens the county’s own filed workbook.
